content.user_title: Build paid-ad audience segments from your data
content.value_statement: Customer and analytics exports can be difficult to turn into consistent advertising audiences. This skill creates named seeds, exclusions, and funnel-stage maps from user-owned data without exposing raw PII.
actual_capabilities: Identifies available CRM or analytics columns for value, recency, tier, source, and fit signals.
Creates named seed audiences tied to traits or behaviors in a user-owned export.
Defines value-based seed lists from a user-provided value field.
Defines customer, recent-purchaser, and bad-fit suppression segments.
Maps cold, warm, hot, and customer audiences across advertising platforms.
Flags missing data as NEEDS_INPUT instead of inventing segment criteria.
limitations: It does not upload audiences or create platform-specific lookalike audiences.
It does not design campaign structures, ad groups, or keyword match types.
It depends on the quality and available columns in user-provided exports.
It does not replace consent, privacy, or advertising-platform compliance reviews.

use_cases.title: Prepare CRM segments for acquisition
use_cases.description: Turn a customer export into high-value seeds and exclusions before launching paid acquisition.

use_cases.title: Align cross-platform retargeting
use_cases.description: Create one funnel-stage map that marketing teams can apply across Google and Meta.

use_cases.title: Document reusable audience rules
use_cases.description: Create clear segment definitions from analytics and CRM fields for future campaign planning.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a customer export
prompt_templates.prompt: Build audience segments from my customer export. My goal is direct response. I plan to use Google and Meta.

prompt_templates.title: Create value-based seeds
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my customer list to define a value-based seed audience from customers with the highest lifetime value. Include exclusions for recent purchasers.

prompt_templates.title: Map GA4 audiences to a funnel
prompt_templates.prompt: Map these GA4 audience and demographics columns into cold, warm, hot, and customer stages for Google and Meta.

prompt_templates.title: Set advanced suppression rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Create platform-neutral seed, lookalike seed, and suppression definitions from this CRM export. Use a 30-day recent-purchaser exclusion and flag missing fit signals.

output_examples.input: Customer export with lifetime value, last-purchase date, plan tier, and refund status.
output: High-value seed: customers in the top lifetime-value tier.
Recent-purchaser suppression: customers who purchased within 30 days.
Bad-fit suppression: refunded or unqualified customers.
Funnel map: high-value seed for prospecting, repeat buyers for warm retargeting.

output_examples.input: GA4 export with page engagement and traffic source columns.
output: Cold audience: new visitors from qualified acquisition sources.
Warm audience: engaged visitors and product-page viewers.
Hot audience: pricing-page visitors with a defined retargeting window.
Missing value field: marked NEEDS_INPUT for value-based seeds.

best_practices: Provide only user-owned exports and confirm that the data has appropriate marketing consent.
Use aggregate descriptions or hashed identifiers instead of sharing raw emails or phone numbers.
State recency windows and source columns for every audience and suppression rule.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to upload customer data or create advertising accounts.
Do not treat a value-based seed list as a platform-generated lookalike audience.
Do not invent value, fit, or recency criteria when the export lacks those fields.

faq.question: What data can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a user-owned CRM, customer, GA4, or audience-list export with available column names and aggregate descriptions.

faq.question: Does this skill upload audiences to ad platforms?
faq.answer: No. It creates audience definitions and seed plans. Platform uploads require a separate authorized workflow.

faq.question: Can it create a lookalike audience?
faq.answer: It creates the value-based seed definition. The advertising platform creates the actual lookalike audience.

faq.question: How does it handle personal data?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to avoid echoing raw PII and to use hashed or aggregate descriptions.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It produces platform-neutral audience definitions that can be used for Google, Meta, and similar advertising platforms.

faq.question: What happens when the export lacks a needed field?
faq.answer: The skill marks the affected audience as NEEDS_INPUT instead of guessing the missing criteria.
